1. **Primary paper — “EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents.”** Introduces a meta-agent that jointly adapts the user simulator, environment, and RL configuration. People: Min Cai (University of Alberta); Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore); Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology); Zhaohui Xu (independent researcher); Xi Ye (University of Alberta and Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute/Amii). [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

2. **Official full-text HTML.** Searchable version of the same paper, including methods, experiments, author affiliations, and reported performance gains. Same authors and affiliations as above. [arXiv HTML](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.16523)

3. **Independent AI review on Pith.** Summarizes the work and flags concerns about unmatched compute budgets and reliance on proprietary meta-agent models. People reviewed: Min Cai, Dan Zhang, Gao Xing, Libin Ma, Zhaohui Xu, and Xi Ye; affiliations as listed above. [Pith review](https://pith.science/paper/2610.16523)

4. **Min Cai’s research page.** Confirms EAU as part of his agent-training research. Person: Min Cai, PhD student at the University of Alberta, supervised by Xi Ye. [Personal research page](https://henrycai11.github.io/)

The query strongly points to one recent research project:

1. **EAU project page — “Environment–Agent–User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents.”** Introduces a meta-agent that jointly adapts the environment, agent, and simulated user during training. People: Min Cai (University of Alberta), Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore), Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology), Zhaohui Xu (independent researcher), and Xi Ye (University of Alberta; Amii).  
   https://eau-meta-agent.github.io/

2. **Official arXiv paper — EAU, arXiv:2610.16523.** Primary paper, submitted October 12, 2026. Reports gains across UserGym, ColBench, and τ²-bench. Same authors and affiliations as above.
